title: Family Paralegal
description:
Family Paralegal 12 months experience Nottinghamshire Competitive Salary + Excellent Benefits

An established and highly regarded law firm in Nottinghamshire is looking for a Family Paralegal to join it's growing team. This is more than a traditional support role. You'll become a trusted part of a department that works closely with individuals and families during some of the most important and sensitive periods of their lives.

Whether you're already working in Family Law or looking to further develop your experience, this is an opportunity to learn from experienced practitioners, take on meaningful responsibility, and be part of a team that genuinely supports one another.

What makes this role different?
This firm believes that great Family Law is about more than legal expertise. It's about empathy, communication, and guiding clients through challenging circumstances with confidence and understanding. You'll work closely with fee earners on a broad range of family matters, gaining hands-on experience while being encouraged to develop your own skills and career ambitions.

The Role
Your day-to-day work will include:
- Supporting solicitors with a varied caseload of family matters
- Drafting correspondence, court documents and legal forms
- Preparing court bundles and hearing documentation
- Communicating with clients, courts, barristers and external agencies
- Assisting with Legal Aid applications and CCMS administration where required
- Conducting legal research and file management tasks
- Ensuring exceptional levels of client care throughout the process
- Playing an active role within a close-knit and collaborative team

Who They're Looking For
The ideal candidate will be someone who enjoys building relationships, takes pride in producing high-quality work, and understands the importance of providing reassurance to clients when they need it most.

You'll likely have:
- Previous experience as a Family Paralegal or Legal Assistant
- Exposure to Legal Aid matters and CCMS processes (beneficial but not essential)
- Excellent organisational and time management skills
- Strong communication and drafting abilities
- A compassionate and professional approach to client care
- A genuine interest in building a long-term career within Family Law

What's in it for You?
Alongside a competitive salary, you'll benefit from:
- Generous annual leave entitlement
- Life assurance scheme
- Employee wellbeing and assistance programme
- Access to counselling and GP services
- Career progression and professional development opportunities
- A supportive management team that invests in its people
- A positive and collaborative working environment

Why Join?
Not every Family Law role offers the chance to be part of a team where people genuinely enjoy working together and supporting one another. This firm has built a strong reputation through its commitment to both its clients and its staff.

If you're looking for a role where you'll be valued, trusted, and given room to grow, this could be the perfect next step in your legal career.

title: Legal Secretary
description:
An established law firm in Mansfield is looking for an experienced Personal Injury Legal Secretary to join its busy and welcoming department.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys the pace of Personal Injury work, takes pride in delivering high-quality secretarial support and wants to join a firm that puts real emphasis on its people, working environment and staff well-being.

You'll be joining an established team, supporting experienced fee earners and playing an important role in keeping a busy department running smoothly.

What makes this opportunity worth considering?
- Salary from £25,500 per Annam.
- Permanent, full-time position offering long-term stability.
- Monday to Friday, 8:30am-5:00pm, with a full hour for lunch.
- Four additional days off over the Christmas period.
- Christmas bonus and long-service rewards.
- Holiday purchase scheme, giving you additional flexibility.
- Free on-site parking.
- Contributory pension.
- Regular staff socials, team-building events and company celebrations.

What will your day look like?

You'll provide essential secretarial support to Personal Injury fee earners, helping ensure files progress efficiently and clients receive an excellent level of service.
Your responsibilities will include:
- Producing and amending legal correspondence and documentation.
- Audio typing and working with digital dictation.
- Managing incoming and outgoing emails, post and telephone calls.
- Maintaining accurate electronic and paper files.
- Liaising with clients, medical experts, insurers and other legal professionals.
- Supporting the progression of Personal Injury matters.
- Monitoring important dates, appointments and deadlines.
- Managing competing priorities and ensuring fee earners receive reliable day-to-day support.

What are we looking for?

We're keen to speak with experienced Legal Secretaries who have:
- At least 2 years experience working as a Legal Secretary within a solicitor's practice.
- At least 2 years experience specifically within Personal Injury.
- Previous experience using digital dictation software.
- Strong audio typing and document production skills.
- Confidence supporting fee earners within a busy legal department.
- Excellent organisation, attention to detail and communication skills.
- A proactive approach and the ability to manage their own workload.

The important details
- Location: Mansfield, NG19 7 AE.
- Salary: From £25,500.
- Hours: Monday-Friday, 8:30am-5:00pm.
- Lunch: One hour.
- Contract: Permanent, full-time.
- Working arrangement: Office-based.

If you're an experienced Personal Injury Legal Secretary looking for a fresh challenge, a positive working environment and a position where you can put your existing experience to good use, this could be an excellent next step in your career.

title: paralegal
description:
Job Title: Paralegal

About the Role

We are seeking a motivated, organised and detail-oriented Paralegal to join a legal team. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with previous legal experience who is looking to develop their skills and progress their career within a professional legal environment.

The successful candidate will provide legal and administrative support to solicitors and fee earners, assisting with case management, legal documentation, client communication and the day-to-day running of legal matters.

Key Responsibilities
- Assisting solicitors and fee earners with the management and progression of legal cases.
- Preparing, drafting and reviewing legal documents and correspondence.
- Conducting legal research and summarising findings where required.
- Maintaining accurate and up-to-date client files and case management records.
- Liaising with clients, courts, counsel, third parties and other relevant organisations.
- Preparing bundles, schedules and supporting documentation.
- Monitoring deadlines and ensuring documents are completed and submitted on time.
- Supporting case preparation and ensuring compliance with relevant procedures.
- Providing general administrative support to the legal team.
- Maintaining confidentiality and delivering a professional standard of client care.

Requirements
- Previous experience working within a legal environment is desirable, with experience requirements depending on the level of the role.
- A law degree, LPC, SQE-related qualification or relevant legal experience would be advantageous.
- Good written and verbal communication skills.
- Strong organisational skills and excellent attention to detail.
- The ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.
- A professional and client-focused approach.
- The ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- Good IT skills and familiarity with legal case management systems would be beneficial.

The Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate will be proactive, reliable and enthusiastic about developing their legal career. They will have a strong work ethic, a willingness to learn and the ability to support a busy legal team effectively.

How to Apply

If you have the relevant skills and experience and are interested in developing your career within the legal sector, we would welcome your application.
